sections.h2: Clients are cutting their own support staff, and Salesforce's fell from 9,000 to 5,000

chart.title: Salesforce's support staff fell from about 9,000 to 5,000 after AI agents took chats
chart.sub: Salesforce's own support staff, about, before and after its AI agents took on about half of conversations.
chart.source: Company statements as reported in the post.

sections.means: Clients are cutting their own support staff, while Concentrix and TTEC show vendor revenue shrinking too.
sections.todo: Track Indian contact-centre headcount against vendor revenue, since the post's evidence shows the two decoupling.

sections.h2: Computer services grew 11.1% in FY26 while BPO was almost flat at 0.4%

chart.title: BPO grew 0.4% in FY26 against 11.1% for computer services
chart.sub: Growth of software and IT-enabled services exports, FY25 to FY26, %.
chart.source: RBI surveys of software exports, Nov 2025 and Sep 2026.

sections.means: The pattern fits AI pressure on voice and back-office work, though currency and pricing could explain part of it.
sections.todo: Compare BPO growth with computer services in the next RBI survey before reading the gap as an AI effect.

sections.h2: The Philippines cut its 2028 outsourcing jobs target, the only hub to do so

chart.title: The Philippines cut its 2028 target from 25 lakh to 18.5-21.4 lakh workers

sections.means: IBPAP cut the target and says AI weakens the link between revenue and entry-level jobs, though the sector still added about 80,000 jobs in 2025.
sections.todo: India should publish and revise its own export-workforce forecast, as IBPAP did, since NASSCOM has no equivalent yet.
